newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PSC says buys 5-floor building.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PSC says buys 5-floor building.

text.p: Shipbuilder PSC Industries Bhd said it had bought a five-floor building in northern Penang state for 9.7 million ringgit in cash.
The company said the building was acquired "due to its strategic locality adjoining the Bayan Lepas Free Trade Zone, which is the hub of industrialisation of the northern region."
The building is being acquired from Lanser Automatik Systems Sdn Bhd, and currently houses Intel Malaysia Sdn Bhd, said the statement.
PSC stock was requoted on Friday following the announcement. At 0650 GMT the stock fell two ringgit to 29.75 ringgit.
